description: This file defines the X509Certificate class, representing an X.509 certificate with methods for setting and retrieving certificate details, cloning, and equality checks.

classes.name: X509Certificate
classes.description: Represents an X.509 certificate with properties such as issuer, subject, serial number, and signature algorithm, including methods for cloning and equality.

methods.name: x509Certificate
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new X509Certificate instance.

methods.name: withCertificate
methods.description: Sets the certificate and its encoded bytes, resets hash code.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current X509Certificate instance.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on certificate details.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on certificate properties.
